group.name: from-Zulip
group.notes: These tests are based on the discussion here: https://chat.fhir.org/#narrow/stream/179266-fhirpath/topic/Singleton.20Evaluation.20of.20Collections In particular, per Singleton Evaluation of Collections, if an argument does not implicitly convert to a boolean, it is considered true if there is a single element, empty otherwise, so `true and 'foo'` evaluates to `true`, which is not empty, but `true | 'foo'` is a collection, which results in an error because `'foo'` cannot be converted to a boolean for consideration in `allTrue()`.

group.name: documentFunctions
group.description: Functions for FHIR documents: section(), entry(), entryIn(), resources(), resourcesIn(), sameSubject() and hasCoding(). These are not part of FHIRPath, nor of the FHIR specification's additional FHIRPath functions - they are an extension of the HL7 Java reference implementation (org.hl7.fhir.core), so other engines run them only if they choose to implement the functions
group.notes:
section(system, code [, min, max]): on documents (Bundles) or Compositions (a document's Composition is its first Composition entry), the Composition's sections, nested ones too, whose code has a coding that matches system and code. min and max default to 1 and 1. entry(system, code [, min, max]): on sections, their entries (resolved in the document) whose code has a coding that matches system and code. min and max default to 0 and *. entryIn(valueSet [, min, max]): as entry(), with a code in the value set (a canonical, with |version or not). Empty if valueSet is empty. resources(system, code [, type]): on documents, or anything in one, every resource in the document whose code has a coding that matches system and code (and of that type, unless type is empty or isn't given). resourcesIn(valueSet [, type]): as resources(), with a code in the value set. Empty if valueSet is empty. sameSubject([other]): whether the focus resource has the same subject (its subject or its patient) as other - or, without other, as the Composition of the document the evaluation is on (a Bundle of type document). Empty if the focus or other isn't a single resource, either has no subject (or more than one), or, without other, the evaluation isn't on a document. Otherwise true if both references are present and identical strings; else if both identifiers are present and have identical system and value; otherwise false. other given as empty ({}) is not the same as no other: the result is empty. hasCoding(system, code [, version]): on Codings or CodeableConcepts, whether any coding matches. A parameter that is a string must match the coding's system, code or version precisely (so a coding without a version doesn't match a version that is given); a parameter that is empty ({}), or the version when it isn't given, is ignored. Empty when the input is empty; otherwise true or false.
A resource's code is its code, vaccineCode or medication (a CodeableConcept, or a CodeableReference's concept). A coding matches system and code as in hasCoding(): a string must match precisely, and an empty one ({}) is ignored. min and max are both given or neither; max may be '*'. Either may be empty ({}), and an empty one - or both, when they aren't given - takes the function's default. Other than sameSubject's other, a parameter is a single value or empty: one that is more than one makes the result empty. When the number found for an input item is outside min..max, that item adds nothing to the output - it is not an error. A value set that can't be found, or a membership that can't be determined, is an error. References are resolved in the document as the validator resolves references in a Bundle: an absolute reference by fullUrl, a relative one (Type/id) against the base of the Composition's fullUrl when that is a RESTful URL (before R4, also by type and id), and '#id' as a resource contained in the Composition. A fragment on a reference is ignored, and more than one match is no match. One that can't be resolved is left out.
